payload.description: How to replace the monthly FP&A grind with a repeatable Claude workflow. Covers setting up a Claude Project as your persistent FP&A workspace, loading planning models, spotting anomalies, updating forecasts, and running scenario analysis. Adapted from Wouter Born's LinkedIn post.
payload.name: Build a Monthly FP&A Planning System Inside Claude
payload.title: Build a Monthly FP&A Planning System Inside Claude
